balance.example_en: She tries to balance study and rest.
balance.example_zh: 她尽量平衡学习和休息。

chip.example_en: He ate a bag of chips at lunch.

cold.example_en: They kept training even though the weather was cold.
cold.example_zh: 即使天气寒冷，他们也一直在训练。

prefer.example_zh: 大多数学生更喜欢小组作业。

presentation.example_zh: 每个人都认真对待这个演示文稿。

appeal.example_en: Camping in the rain doesn't appeal to me.
appeal.example_zh: 雨中露营对我没有吸引力。

brush.example_en: I brush my teeth every night.

contact.example_en: Contact the teacher if you have a question.
contact.example_zh: 如果有问题，请联系老师。

lift.example_en: We took the lift up to the fifth floor.

no.example_en: There is no milk left in the fridge.

order.example_en: We ordered a bowl of noodles for lunch.
order.example_zh: 我们午饭点了一碗面条。

panic.example_en: Don't panic if you miss the first bus.
panic.example_zh: 如果没赶上第一班公交，也不要恐慌。

potential.example_en: She has the potential to be a great singer.
potential.example_zh: 她有潜力成为一名出色的歌手。

repair.example_en: Dad can repair my bike this weekend.
repair.example_zh: 爸爸这周末能给我修自行车。

smile.example_en: She met me with a warm smile.
smile.example_zh: 她带着温暖的微笑迎接我。

waste.example_en: Don't waste the evening watching TV.
waste.example_zh: 不要把晚上的时间浪费在看电视上。

eighteenth.example_en: Her birthday is on the eighteenth of June.
eighteenth.example_zh: 她的生日是六月十八日。

Mount Huangshan.example_en: Mount Huangshan is famous for pine trees and a sea of clouds.
Mount Huangshan.example_zh: 黄山以松树和云海闻名。

high-rise.example_en: A new high-rise beside the station has shops on the ground floor.
high-rise.example_zh: 车站旁的一座新高层建筑，底层有商店。

side road.example_en: We turned onto a quiet side road to avoid the traffic.
side road.example_zh: 我们拐上一条安静的支路，好避开堵车。
